journey.name: PIN Gates Allowance Changes
journey.description:
When the payer requires a PIN for payments, setting an allowance and ending it ask for the same PIN (or biometrics) as Send before anything changes, and a cancelled check changes nothing. The payee's answers never ask. Automatic payments under an accepted allowance never ask: the checked grant is their authorisation.
Precondition: the two-instance setup in README.md, with no allowance between them yet. On the payer, enable a PIN you choose under Settings ▸ Security ▸ PIN Code and turn on "Also require for payments"; no biometrics enrolled on the emulator, so the PIN pad shows directly. Never enter a wrong PIN more than once.

actions.action: On the payer instance, open Subscriptions, tap the Allowances tab, tap Add (testTag "AllowanceAdd"), pick the payee and keep $5 a payment and $50 a month
Verify the PIN pad shows over the sheet, then press back
Verify the Set sheet (testTag "SetAllowance") is still showing with the same payee and limits, and the payee instance gets no review sheet
Tap Save Allowance again and enter the PIN
Verify the sheet dismisses and the payer's row reads "Waiting for an answer"
On the payee instance, verify the review sheet (testTag "AllowanceReview") opens on its own, tap Accept (testTag "AllowanceAccept") and verify no PIN is asked
On the payee instance, send the payer a one-time Payment Request for $2 and verify the payer pays it automatically with no PIN pad, per auto-pay-under-limit.xml
On the payer instance, tap the payee's row and swipe "Swipe To End Allowance" to the end
Verify the PIN pad shows, press back, and verify the detail sheet (testTag "AllowanceDetail") is back with the swipe control at its start and the allowance still Active
Swipe it to the end again, enter the PIN, and verify the row reads "Ended · $2.00 paid automatically"
